requirements.description: Visitor enters email and clicks Subscribe; email must be valid format, max 100 chars
API: POST /api/subscribe {email} returns 201, 400 on invalid email, 409 on duplicate

testCases.title: Subscribe with a new valid email
testCases.preconditions: Visitor on page with signup form; email not yet subscribed
steps: Enter the email in the Email field
testCases.expected: Success confirmation shown (text per assumption A1); subscription record created for new.user@example.com; no error displayed

testCases.title: Subscribe with email containing plus-tag and subdomain
testCases.expected: Accepted as valid format; success confirmation shown; record stored with the exact address

testCases.title: Submit using Enter key in email field
steps: Press Enter instead of clicking Subscribe
testCases.expected: Form submits once; same success confirmation as clicking Subscribe

testCases.title: Reject empty email on Subscribe
testCases.expected: Validation error shown on Email field; no request creates a subscription; no success message

testCases.title: Reject email missing @ symbol
testCases.expected: Invalid-email validation error shown; no subscription created

testCases.title: Reject email missing domain part
testCases.expected: Invalid-email validation error shown; no subscription created

testCases.title: Reject email with multiple @ or spaces inside
testCases.expected: Both rejected with invalid-email error; no subscription created

testCases.title: Reject script injection in email field
testCases.expected: Rejected as invalid format; no script executes; input is HTML-escaped in any echoed message; nothing stored

testCases.title: Reject SQL injection string in email field
testCases.expected: Rejected as invalid (or handled safely); no DB error or stack trace shown; subscriber table unchanged

testCases.title: Accept email of exactly 99 characters
testCases.expected: Accepted; success confirmation; full 99-char address stored untruncated

testCases.title: Accept email of exactly 100 characters (max)
testCases.expected: Accepted; success confirmation; full 100-char address stored untruncated

testCases.title: Reject email of 101 characters (max+1)
testCases.expected: Either input blocks the 101st char (maxlength=100) or a max-length error is shown; no subscription created; value not silently truncated and saved

testCases.title: Accept shortest plausible valid email
testCases.expected: Accepted as valid format; success confirmation shown

testCases.title: Show Already subscribed for duplicate email
testCases.expected: Message "Already subscribed" displayed; no second record created; no success message

testCases.title: Detect duplicate regardless of letter case
testCases.expected: "Already subscribed" shown; no new record (assumption A2: comparison is case-insensitive)

testCases.title: Trim leading and trailing spaces before validation and duplicate check
steps: Enter the email with surrounding spaces
testCases.expected: Spaces trimmed; treated as duplicate and "Already subscribed" shown (assumption A3)

testCases.title: Double-click Subscribe creates only one subscription
testCases.expected: Exactly one subscription record; user sees a single success message (button disabled while submitting, or second call returns duplicate handled gracefully)

testCases.title: Different email after a duplicate still subscribes
testCases.expected: Previous message cleared; success confirmation shown; new record created

testCases.title: Network failure during submit shows recoverable error
testCases.preconditions: Email not yet subscribed; network can be throttled/offline
testCases.expected: Generic error shown (not success); entered email retained; retry after reconnect succeeds

testCases.title: Internationalized (unicode) email handling
testCases.expected: Behaviour matches the agreed policy (open question Q2): either accepted and stored intact, or rejected with invalid-email error; no crash or garbled data

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe returns 201 for new valid email
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 201 Created; JSON body; subscriber api.new@example.com persisted exactly once

apiTestCases.title: POST /api/subscribe returns 409 for duplicate email
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 409 Conflict; error body indicates "Already subscribed"; no new record

apiTestCases.title: Return 400 for invalid email format
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400 Bad Request; error body identifies invalid email; nothing persisted

apiTestCases.title: Return 400 when email field is missing
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400 Bad Request; error mentions email is required

apiTestCases.title: Return 400 for malformed JSON body
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400 Bad Request; no stack trace in body

apiTestCases.title: Reject unsupported method GET on /api/subscribe
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 405 Method Not Allowed (assumption A4); subscriber list NOT exposed

apiTestCases.title: Accept 100-character email (max)
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 201 Created; stored email is 100 chars, untruncated

apiTestCases.title: Reject 101-character email (max+1)
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400 Bad Request; error indicates max length 100; nothing persisted (server-side enforcement independent of UI)

apiTestCases.title: Return 409 for duplicate with different letter case
Concurrent identical requests create one record
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: Exactly one 201, remaining 409; exactly one DB record (unique constraint holds)

apiTestCases.title: Ignore or reject unknown extra fields
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 201 (or 400 if strict schema); extra fields NOT persisted (no mass assignment)

apiTestCases.title: Reject request with wrong Content-Type
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 400 Bad Request or 415 Unsupported Media Type (open question Q5); nothing persisted

apiTestCases.title: Rate limiting on repeated subscribe calls
apiTestCases.preconditions: Rate limit policy defined (open question Q4)
steps: Send 100 requests from one IP within 1 minute
apiTestCases.expectedResponse: 429 Too Many Requests once threshold exceeded (if rate limiting is in scope)

assumptions: A1: Success message text is not specified; tests verify a visible success confirmation and record creation.
A2: Duplicate detection is case-insensitive on the whole address.
A3: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed before validation and duplicate check.
A4: Only POST is supported on /api/subscribe; other methods return 405.
No user roles or authentication apply; signup is open to anonymous visitors (no role matrix created).
openQuestions: Q1: What exact success message (and any double opt-in/confirmation email) follows a successful subscribe?
Q2: Which email format rule applies (RFC 5322, simple regex, internationalized addresses allowed)?
Q3: Is duplicate matching case-insensitive and whitespace-trimmed? Are unsubscribed emails treated as duplicates?
Q4: Is there rate limiting / CAPTCHA to prevent abuse, and what are the thresholds?
Q5: Does the API require authentication, and what response schema/body is returned for 201/400/409/415?
